title.zh: 【万事达卡与 BVNK 推出法币及稳定币一体化平台】
title.en: 【万事达卡与 BVNK 推出法币及稳定币一体化平台】

current_state.zh: Mastercard and BVNK launched Global Money Platform, a single-API product letting banks, fintechs and enterprises embed fiat and stablecoin multi-currency accounts, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards and local bank payouts via Mastercard Move.
current_state.en: Mastercard and BVNK launched Global Money Platform, a single-API product letting banks, fintechs and enterprises embed fiat and stablecoin multi-currency accounts, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards and local bank payouts via Mastercard Move.

updates.title_zh: 【万事达卡与 BVNK 推出法币及稳定币一体化平台】
updates.title_en: 【万事达卡与 BVNK 推出法币及稳定币一体化平台】
updates.what_changed_zh:
万事达卡（Mastercard）与 BVNK 推出 Global Money Platform，通过单一 API 让银行、金融科技公司和企业嵌入同时承载法币与稳定币的多币种账户，并支持两者之间的实时兑换、稳定币关联卡以及通过 Mastercard Move 向本地银行账户付款。该平台目前已通过 BVNK 开放使用，是自 2026 年 8 月万事达卡完成对 BVNK 的收购以来，双方能力的首次重大整合。

该平台把稳定币余额直接接入万事达卡的卡组织与付款通道，而非置于其外，使银行、金融科技公司和企业可以通过单一接口完成两种形态资金的持有、兑换、转账与消费。Nuvei、Marqeta 以及 Ontop、Beem、Almond FinTech 属于首批接入方。

万事达卡表示，通过 Mastercard Move 进行的本地货币付款预计到 2027 年将覆盖 200 多个国家的 40 多种货币，发卡服务可在 130 多个国家提供。公司称该平台后续将增加对 agentic commerce（智能体商务）和代币化存款的支持。

updates.background_zh: 万事达卡于 2026 年 3 月宣布以最高 18 亿美元（含 3 亿美元或有对价）收购稳定币基础设施提供商 BVNK，交易于 8 月完成。万事达卡将新平台定位为面向“多货币（multi-money）”世界的基础设施，其区块链与数字资产执行副总裁 Raj Dhamodharan 表示，未来商业将建立在多种货币形式的互操作性之上。万事达卡此前还取得了覆盖稳定币和代币化存款的纽约 BitLicense。
updates.background_en: Mastercard announced a definitive agreement to acquire BVNK, a stablecoin infrastructure provider, for up to $1.8 billion including $300 million in contingent payments, in March 2026; the deal closed in August. Mastercard framed the new platform as infrastructure for a "multi-money" world, and Raj Dhamodharan, the company's executive vice president for blockchain and digital assets, said the future of commerce will be built on interoperability across multiple forms of money. Mastercard has also secured a New York BitLicense covering stablecoins and tokenized deposits.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该平台扩大了受监管金融机构持有、兑换和使用稳定币余额的分发渠道，把稳定币结算与万事达卡的商户受理网络及 Mastercard Move 付款网络连接起来。这使稳定币发行方及其储备与托管安排、加密支付处理商和发卡平台面临机构支付资金流进入链上通道方式的变化，不过该平台为分阶段推进，完整的本地付款覆盖预计要到 2027 年才能实现。
updates.market_impact_en: The platform widens the distribution channel through which stablecoin balances can be held, converted and spent by regulated financial institutions, linking stablecoin settlement to Mastercard's card acceptance and Mastercard Move payout network. That exposes stablecoin issuers and their reserve/custody arrangements, crypto payment processors and card-issuing platforms to a shift in how institutional payment flows reach on-chain rails, although rollout is phased and full payout coverage is not expected until 2027.
